Before we get to the witness list, I want to gently name what stands out to me: this is your third DUI in five years, and you've shared that the drinking has crept back in when you thought it had stopped. That pattern matters, and I think it deserves as much of your attention as the court strategy does.

The legal consequences are real and worth taking seriously, but even an ankle monitor won't address the drinking itself—and that's the thing most likely to keep pulling you back into situations like this. Would you be open to talking with your attorney about treatment options too? Courts often view someone actively seeking help more favorably, and it could genuinely change the road ahead.

If it helps, I'm glad to think through character witnesses with you. But I'd also encourage reaching out to a substance use counselor or a line like SAMHSA's at 1-800-662-4357. What feels most pressing to you right now?
